trigger: customer enters DSH without an active order
state_effect: reveals lawful store, category, and item entry context

trigger: customer selects purchasable items and proceeds toward confirmation
state_effect: moves cart state toward a validated checkout intent

trigger: customer confirms the order after checkout gating passes
state_effect: creates an order that becomes visible for downstream partner handling

trigger: customer re-enters with an active or terminal order
state_effect: reflects cross-surface lifecycle visibility back to the customer

trigger: an active order requires participant communication
state_effect: updates chat state around the active order without moving ownership

trigger: a submitted order reaches the store-side handling stage
state_effect: moves the order through store-side preparation and handoff states

trigger: partner workspace detects readiness, inventory, or zone issues
state_effect: updates store readiness and routing preconditions for fulfillment

trigger: partner handoff or offer publication reaches a captain
state_effect: moves a delivery from offer visibility into accepted ownership

trigger: a captain accepts a delivery and begins execution
state_effect: progresses delivery toward completion while exposing lawful visibility elsewhere

trigger: execution reaches a proof-gated completion point
state_effect: records, verifies, and exposes completion proof for lawful closeout

trigger: field participation is explicitly opened for activation or visit work
state_effect: updates optional activation or support state without expanding default ownership

trigger: customer enters the proxy exception branch
state_effect: moves the proxy case across submission, review, and decision states

trigger: internal operations intervene on DSH execution or policy conditions
state_effect: applies governance-side state changes without taking over external actor ownership
